concept_name: urea c-13 75 MG Powder for Oral Solution [Helicobacter Test INFAI breath test kit]
comment: Oral powder for reconstitution; the source container unit does not indicate an injection route.

Soluble tablet dissolved in water before drinking (100 mg in 125 ml for adults; 50 mg in 50 ml for children). No matching soluble-tablet concept found; Disintegrating Oral Tablet denotes dissolution in the mouth and is unsuitable. Citral Pylori is a separately administered test meal.
